cells.gaps: No fact says any commissariat or brigade enters reports or cases in SIPAO, which records, or how: the police statement of 14 April 2026 is that all stations have the tool, a share equipped and not a share recording, and it gives no count of stations. No plan or source of finance has been found, and the statement is not a dated event of advance in the last twelve months. TGO-001 and TGO-002 are from the excluded source and set nothing.
cells.note: All commissariats and gendarmerie brigades were said on 14 April 2026 to have the SIPAO tool, inside 36 months of the as-at, which is preparation. Stage 3 needs a record system live in stations, and no fact says a station enters a report or a case in it.
